title: DARKER THAN BLACK: Kuro no Keiyakusha - Sakura no Hana no Mankai no Shita
justification: AniList 4182 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2008-03-27) is AniDB 4906's special S1 Sakura no Hana no Mankai no Shita (Beneath Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom...), aired 2008-03-26, one day before AniList's date. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 2025, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 4906, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji and English titles (and native 桜の花の満開の下). The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 Beneath Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom... (2008-03-26) and on TMDB 31718 S0E1 (2008-03-26).
